Site.name: Victor's Picks
Site.tagline: A bilingual Bay Area tech events calendar. See where I'm going, subscribe only to what you care about.
Site.sample: Sample data — these 20 events are placeholders for design review, not real listings.

Home.title: This week's picks
Home.empty: Nothing in these categories this week that I'd recommend. Try widening the filter.

Event.refreshNote: Calendar apps refresh subscriptions on their own schedule; cancellations also go out by email.

Calendar.title: Calendar
Calendar.description: Every pick by month, with a day-by-day agenda. Subscribe to the categories you care about.

Going.title: Where Victor is going
Going.intro: Only events I've publicly marked. Private venues, cycling and repeat meetups never show up here ahead of time.

Week.title: Week of {date}
Week.description: Victor's picks for the week of {date}: Bay Area tech events, with a note on why each one is worth going to.

About.title: About
About.body1: I'm Victor, a Berkeley student who goes to a lot of Bay Area tech events. Every week I pick the ones I'd actually recommend and say why in a line or two.
About.body2: You can see which ones I'm going to, filter by the categories you care about, and subscribe by calendar feed. Every page is in English and Chinese.
About.body3: No paid placements. Hosts can't buy their way onto this list.

Subscribe.going: Subscribe to where Victor is going
Subscribe.urlHint: Paste into any calendar app that accepts a URL.
Subscribe.refresh: Calendar apps refresh on their own schedule: Apple in 15 minutes to a few hours, Outlook in 3–12 hours, Google in 12–24 hours or longer. Cancellations also go out by email.

Newsletter.title: Get the picks by email
Newsletter.lead: One email on Sunday evening, only the categories you pick. No paid placements.
Newsletter.metaDescription: Victor's weekly Bay Area tech event picks by email, in English or Chinese, only the categories you choose.

form.privacy: I only use your email to send this newsletter. Every email has a one-click unsubscribe.
